nodes.label: Spark & Reachy Photo Booth overview
nodes.rationale: Runs LLM, image gen, ASR, TTS and CV models locally on DGX Spark without cloud dependencies; services communicate through a message bus.

nodes.label: NVIDIA Security Vulnerability Reporting (PSIRT)
nodes.rationale: Vulnerabilities must be reported via NVIDIA web form or psirt@nvidia.com, not GitHub, under coordinated disclosure.

nodes.label: UMA buffer cache flush workaround
nodes.rationale: DGX Spark Unified Memory Architecture can cause memory issues for apps not yet UMA-aware; flush drop_caches.

nodes.label: Local DGX Spark Deployment Only Notice
nodes.norm_label: local dgx spark deployment only notice
nodes.rationale: Reference implementation, not production-ready; services must not be exposed beyond trusted local environment.

nodes.label: Interaction Manager
nodes.rationale: Coordinates robot state and conversation flow for event-driven interaction between user, robot and AI agent.

nodes.label: Room Mapping Coordinate System
nodes.rationale: Robot at origin; X forward toward user, Y left; only direction matters, not distance.

nodes.label: Motor PID Tuning (hardware_config.yaml)
nodes.rationale: Reduce base/antenna vibration; raising D smooths motion, P raises accuracy but can overshoot; change one value at a time.

nodes.label: workmesh.photo_gate.PhotoGate
nodes.rationale: Requires valid detection within 1.5s; does not require full-body box centering because tracker targets nose/neck; duplicate frames do not refresh presence.

nodes.label: Photo Capture Flow with Fresh Detection Checks
nodes.norm_label: photo capture flow with fresh detection checks
nodes.rationale: Requires a new person detection before preparation and again after countdown; missing people cancel the request; 45s preparation limit stays below the agent's 60s acknowledgement timeout.

nodes.label: udev rules 99-reachy-mini.rules
nodes.rationale: Lets Docker access ReSpeaker recording device for Direction-of-Arrival and recording.

nodes.label: input_device_index_or_name / audio_config.sample_rate
nodes.rationale: Partial case-insensitive name match falls back to default device; matching sample_rate prevents input errors.

nodes.label: Spark & Reachy Photo Booth UI README
nodes.norm_label: spark & reachy photo booth ui readme

nodes.label: Controlled Kiosk Environment Assumption
nodes.rationale: Speech-controlled UI in recent Firefox on reliable private network: no accessibility, SEO, retries, vendor prefixes or interactive states needed.

nodes.label: Websocket-Driven Minimal UI State (useWebsocket)
nodes.rationale: UI is a function of websocket state; complex state lives in ui-server-service; Context API, redux, zustand forbidden.

nodes.rationale: Animation Compositor, Animation Database and Text-to-Speech must use the same sample rate for proper playback.

nodes.label: talkingForward Speech Animation
nodes.rationale: Five-second loop with gentle pitch nods and no body/head yaw; replaces shoulder-turning clips; tracking motion paused during speech.

nodes.label: cache_kokoro_model_and_voices.py
nodes.rationale: Warm model cache before deployment to reduce first-request latency.

nodes.label: Shared Audio Configuration Requirement
nodes.rationale: Animation Compositor, Animation Database and TTS must use the same audio configuration for proper operation.

nodes.label: Metrics Service
nodes.rationale: Derives OpenTelemetry metrics passively from Kafka message flow; no HTTP API; exports via OTLP gRPC.

nodes.label: Auto-summarization of conversation history
nodes.rationale: Trims history every N turns to stay within LLM context limits.

nodes.label: Typed Topic with Protobuf serialization
nodes.rationale: Topic carries both Kafka name and message type, guaranteeing correct topic id and type-safe deserialization via SerializeToString/ParseFromString.

nodes.rationale: Top-down render of the Reachy Mini head (two antennas) showing which way head translation axes point, so developers can map head_position_x/y parameters to physical motion.

nodes.label: graphify Knowledge Graph Usage Rules
nodes.rationale: Query the graph before grepping raw files because scoped subgraphs are much smaller than raw grep output or GRAPH_REPORT.md.

nodes.label: LGTM (observability stack)
nodes.rationale: Shown as standalone infrastructure (Loki/Grafana/Tempo/Mimir) with no drawn connections.

nodes.label: Message Bus (Redpanda)
nodes.rationale: Central hub: every application service connects only to the bus, never directly to each other (hub-and-spoke, event-driven decoupling).

nodes.label: MinIO
nodes.rationale: Shown as standalone infrastructure (object storage) with no drawn connections.

nodes.label: Procedural Audio API Guide
nodes.rationale: Refactored to be modular and composable: a base frequency generator combined with a chain of effects.

nodes.label: Velocity-driven custom volume/pitch envelopes
nodes.rationale: Joint velocity normalized to 0-1 drives volume and pitch; custom envelopes override fade params and are auto-resampled.

nodes.label: Remote Control Panel
nodes.rationale: Manual trigger interface for driving the robot state machine / agent events without real sensor input

nodes.label: Remote Control UI Screenshot
nodes.rationale: Web page with a grid of blue buttons, each mapped to a numeric keyboard shortcut (1-0) plus End, for manually triggering robot state/events. A log/output panel sits below. Designed for operators to step through the photo booth flow or simulate events during testing.

nodes.label: Camera Service
nodes.rationale: Abstracts physical and simulator (Unity) cameras behind a consistent interface for easy switching.

nodes.label: GET /capture fresh person-detection requirement (HTTP 409)
nodes.rationale: Capture rejected with 409 without a fresh tracker detection matching the current frame; tracker must run until capture completes.
